text: {"name":"bt_profile_cmd_handle","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Appends profile payload data to a shared buffer capped at 800 bytes, then dispatches to a vendor command or connection-profile setup based on the record's control field.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v2":"profile_context","v3":"input_length","v4":"profile_setup_arg","v5":"buffered_length","v6":"copy_length","v7":"payload_cursor","v8":"payload_destination"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Input record length; values above 5 determine the payload copy length."},{"offset":14,"meaning":"Input control field passed to connection-profile setup; zero selects the vendor-command path."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Input command identifier, masked with 0x3fff for the vendor command."},{"offset":18,"meaning":"Start of the input payload."},{"offset":14,"meaning":"Profile-context buffered payload length."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Profile-context length copied by this call."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Start of the profile-context payload buffer."}]}
